_comment: Ceilings for how far this backend may differ from the committed (WebGL2-blessed) references. A LIST OF DEBTS, not of blessings: every entry is an undiagnosed WebGPU-vs-WebGL2 disagreement. The gate fails when a frame exceeds its ceiling, or when an unlisted frame exceeds the tolerance. Entries are meant to be removed; run.mjs names the ones that have improved enough to tighten. A ceiling must hold on EVERY adapter that gates against it — CI's Dawn/Vulkan-SwiftShader and developers' hardware adapters — so record the larger of the two when they disagree.
